title: Business intelligence, within reach.
body: I built a shared information system from the ground up, putting up-to-date business intelligence at the team’s fingertips.
detail: For a growing business, I took ownership of making essential information easier to find, keep current, and use. The system is now part of the team’s everyday work.

sections.label: THE CHALLENGE
sections.copy: As the business grew, valuable information became harder to keep in view. The team needed a dependable way to get the context behind its work.

sections.label: MY CONTRIBUTION
sections.copy: I built most of the system from the ground up and continue to keep it useful through timely updates and ongoing improvements. My focus is simple: the information people need should be ready when they need it.

sections.label: THE DIFFERENCE
sections.copy: The team now has current information and reporting at its fingertips. Colleagues can work asynchronously, and new team members can get up to speed with shared context. A small team can stay on top of more.
